1	# Supplier Onboarding (New supplier registration and approval): Feature Specification
2	
3	## 1. Document Status
4	
5	- Run ID: 20261012-055017-ac3509
6	- Date: 2026-10-12
7	- Run mode: fixture
8	- Publication status: pending final pass
9	- Known limitations: Capture covers one page only (the New supplier form); no confirmation, error, empty or loading states, and no approver or verification screens, were captured. Research on bank detail changes after approval found no citable source (sources paywalled, members-only or off-topic). Research on audit records found only low-confidence generic fixture guidance, not COSO or UK audit practice; one finding was dropped in verification. Research for the deferred gaps was not performed.
10	- Open stale items: none
11	- Unresolved blocking issues: Q-001, Q-002, Q-003, Q-004 and Q-005 are blocking and unanswered (see section 16).
12	
13	## 2. Executive Summary
14	
15	This feature lets Procurement staff register a new supplier (company name, VAT number and bank details) and requires a Finance team member to approve it before the supplier can be paid. The customer also requires bank details to be verified before approval. The customer's answers say verification is a phone call to the supplier on a number from an independent source, that one approval from any Finance team member is enough, that the approver must differ from the registrant, and that a rejected supplier goes back to its registrant to correct and resubmit.
16	
17	The only mockup screen captured is the registration form. It does not show where Finance verifies and approves, how payment is blocked, what the registrant sees after submitting, or how bank details are entered (the form has a file upload, while the customer defined three fields). Key open decisions are listed in section 16; five of them block a complete specification: where review and approval happen, how unapproved suppliers are kept from payment, what happens when bank details change after approval, what a failed phone check means, and how bank details are entered.
18	
19	## 3. Goals and Scope
20	
21	### Goals
22	
23	- Procurement staff can register new suppliers with company name, VAT number and bank details. [Customer: REQ-001 · Conflicting]
24	- A new supplier cannot be paid until a Finance team member other than the registrant has approved it. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: FEA-006 · Explicit]
25	- Bank details are phone-verified before approval. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit]
26	
27	### In Scope
28	
29	- Supplier registration by Procurement staff, including the format-only VAT check and duplicate VAT blocking. [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Customer: FEA-004 · Explicit]
30	- Phone verification of bank details, approval by one Finance team member, and rejection with return to the registrant. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit]
31	- The approved gaps in section 7 (GAP-001 to GAP-007, GAP-009 and GAP-011) are in scope to be resolved; none is resolved yet.
32	
33	### Out of Scope / Rejected
34	
35	Information unavailable: no decision rejected an item and the customer's requirements excluded nothing. Exclusions are not inferred from absence in the mockup.
36	
37	### Deferred
38	
39	- GAP-008 (Deferred: DEC-005): who may register, view and edit suppliers and their bank details, and how long bank details and rejected registrations are kept.
40	- GAP-010 (Deferred: DEC-005): non-UK suppliers, accepted VAT number formats and required fields.
41	- GAP-012 (Deferred: DEC-005): accessibility of form errors, status messages and the file chooser.
42	
43	## 4. Users and Roles
44	
45	- Procurement staff register new suppliers. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit]
46	- Finance team members can approve a new supplier; one approval is enough; a finance approver phones the supplier to verify bank details. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit]
47	- Unknown: whether people outside Procurement staff are prevented from registering, whether a Finance team member who is also Procurement staff may register, and how the product identifies Finance and Procurement members. [Assumption: ASM-G-002 · Assumption]
48	- Unknown: whether the product can identify the individual who registers and the individual who approves. [Assumption: ASM-F-001 · Assumption]
49	
50	## 5. Existing Mockup Coverage
51	
52	- SCR-001 "New supplier" screen: a form with Company name and VAT number text inputs, a Bank details file chooser and a Submit for approval button; observed state is the default empty form only. [Mockup: SCR-001 · Observed]
53	- SCR-002 form component: no field shows a required marker; the action "Submit for approval" is a button that is not visibly disabled. [Mockup: SCR-002 · Observed]
54	- SCR-003 flow: the Submit for approval button has no target, so the destination after submitting is not shown. [Mockup: SCR-003 · Observed]
55	- SCR-004 Supplier data entity: Company name, VAT number and Bank details are visible fields; Approval status is inferred and not visible. [Mockup: SCR-004 · Observed]
56	- Ambiguous behaviours not answered by the mockup: required fields and validation rules; accepted file types, sizes and storage for Bank details; who can view bank details after upload; what happens on submit, on failure, and on resubmission; downstream changes and notifications.
57	- Capture limitation: one page captured with status complete; no confirmation, error, empty or loading states beyond the default form. Other screens may exist that were not captured. [Assumption: ASM-G-001 · Assumption]
58	
59	## 6. Requirements Traceability
60	
61	| REQ | Requirement | Treatment | Label | References |
62	|---|---|---|---|---|
63	| REQ-001 | Procurement staff register new suppliers with company name, VAT number and bank details. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-001, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006, FR-007, FR-013, FR-014, FR-017; DEC-004 |
64	| REQ-002 | A finance approver must approve a new supplier before it can be paid. | partially addressed | Unknown | FR-002, FR-008, FR-009, FR-011, FR-012, FR-015; DEC-002, DEC-003 |
65	| REQ-003 | Bank details must be verified before approval. | partially addressed | Unknown | FR-003, FR-010, FR-016; DEC-001 |
66	
67	## 7. Gaps Identified
68	
69	| GAP | Gap | Approval | Path | Priority | Status | Rationale |
70	|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
71	| GAP-001 | Approval and bank-detail verification steps not shown in the capture | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | critical | open (customer decision pending: Q-001) | The capture shows only the registrant's form. |
72	| GAP-002 | How payment is blocked until a supplier is approved | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | critical | open (customer decision pending: Q-002) | No document says where payments are made or how an unapproved supplier is stopped. |
73	| GAP-003 | Bank details changed after approval | Approved: DEC-005 | both | critical | open (researched; customer decision pending: Q-003) | Research found no citable source; DEC-003 did not answer this part. |
74	| GAP-004 | Bank details captured as a file upload but defined as three data fields | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | important | open (customer decision pending: Q-005) | DEC-004 and the captured form disagree. |
75	| GAP-005 | Verification failure path versus rejection | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | important | open (customer decision pending: Q-004) | Whether a failed phone check is a rejection is not stated. |
76	| GAP-006 | Outcome of Submit for approval not shown in the capture | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | important | open (customer decision pending; recorded as implementation detail) | Success, error and upload failure states were not captured. |
77	| GAP-007 | Traceability of registration, verification and approval | Approved: DEC-005 | both | important | open (researched; customer decision pending: Q-006) | Two low-confidence findings kept; framework question unanswered. |
78	| GAP-008 | Who may register, view and edit suppliers and their bank details | Deferred: DEC-005 | both | important | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred by the customer. |
79	| GAP-009 | Who is told when a supplier is submitted or returned | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | important | open (customer decision pending: Q-007) | Notification channel and delivery failure not defined. |
80	| GAP-010 | Non-UK suppliers and field formats | Deferred: DEC-005 | both | important | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred by the customer. |
81	| GAP-011 | Duplicate and simultaneous submissions | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | optional | open (customer decision pending: Q-008) | Which records count as existing is not stated. |
82	| GAP-012 | Accessibility of the registration form errors and file upload | Deferred: DEC-005 | research | optional | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred by the customer. |
83	
84	## 8. Functional Requirements
85	
86	### Supplier registration
87	
88	Procurement staff register a new supplier on the New supplier form and submit it for approval.
89	
90	#### Confirmed requirements
91	
92	- **FR-001** Procurement staff register new suppliers with company name, VAT number and bank details. This requirement conflicts with the captured form, which collects bank details only as a file upload. [Customer: REQ-001 · Conflicting] [Decision: DEC-004] [Mockup: SCR-002]
93	- **FR-004** Registration of new suppliers is performed by Procurement staff. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-001]
94	- **FR-005** Bank details consist of account name, sort code and account number. [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
95	- **FR-006** The VAT number is checked for format only. Which formats count as valid is not stated. [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
96	- **FR-007** A supplier with the same VAT number as an existing supplier is blocked at registration. [Customer: FEA-004 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
97	
98	#### Open behaviour (not yet decided)
99	
100	- **FR-013** Undecided: whether bank details are typed as account name, sort code and account number, uploaded as a file, or both, and which values are verified and stored (Q-005). [Inferred: FEA-012 · Unknown]
101	- **FR-014** Undecided: what the registrant sees on successful submission, invalid VAT format, blocked duplicate VAT number and upload failure, and how they later find a returned supplier. [Inferred: FEA-013 · Unknown]
102	- **FR-017** Undecided: which supplier records (pending, rejected, returned) count as existing for the duplicate VAT rule, and what happens on simultaneous or repeated submission (Q-008). [Inferred: FEA-005 · Unknown]
103	
104	#### Recommendations awaiting approval
105	
106	None for this area.
107	
108	#### Acceptance criteria
109	
110	- **AC-001** Given a Procurement staff member on the New supplier form, When they submit a company name, a VAT number in a valid format, and bank details (account name, sort code, account number), Then the supplier is created awaiting Finance approval and is not payable; what the registrant sees is undecided (FR-014). [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
111	- **AC-002** Given a Procurement staff member on the New supplier form, When they submit a VAT number that fails the format check, Then no supplier is created; the message wording is undecided (FR-014). [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
112	- **AC-003** Given an existing supplier with VAT number V, When a Procurement staff member submits a new supplier with VAT number V, Then the submission is blocked and no new supplier is created; whether pending or rejected suppliers count as existing is undecided (FR-017). [Customer: FEA-004 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
113	
114	### Verification and approval
115	
116	A Finance team member phones the supplier to verify bank details and then approves or rejects the supplier.
117	
118	#### Confirmed requirements
119	
120	- **FR-002** A finance approver must approve a new supplier before it can be paid. [Customer: REQ-002 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-002]
121	- **FR-003** Bank details must be verified before approval. [Customer: REQ-003 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-001]
122	- **FR-008** Only members of the Finance team can approve a new supplier; one approval is sufficient; the approver must be a different person from whoever registered the supplier. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
123	- **FR-010** Before approval, a finance approver phones the supplier on a number from an independent source and confirms the bank details; if they do not match, the supplier cannot be approved until the details are corrected. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
124	- **FR-011** A rejected supplier goes back to the person who registered it, who can correct the details and resubmit it. [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]
125	
126	#### Open behaviour (not yet decided)
127	
128	- **FR-012** Undecided: where and how a Finance team member finds a submitted supplier, records the phone verification, and approves or rejects it; only the registration form was captured (Q-001). [Inferred: FEA-011 · Unknown]
129	- **FR-016** Undecided: whether changing an approved supplier's bank details requires re-verification and re-approval, who may make the change, and whether payments are held meanwhile; also whether a failed phone check is a rejection or a separate state, what happens if the supplier cannot be reached, and whether corrected details need a new phone check (Q-003, Q-004). [Inferred: FEA-010 · Unknown]
130	
131	#### Recommendations awaiting approval
132	
133	- **FR-020** Recommendation: record reliably which person registered each supplier and which person attempts approval, including after a returned supplier is corrected and resubmitted, so the separation-of-duties rule can be enforced. [Inferred: FEA-018 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Assumption: ASM-F-001 · Assumption] [Assumption: ASM-F-002 · Assumption]
134	- **FR-021** Recommendation: consider what happens if two Finance members act on the same supplier at once, so that only one decision takes effect. [Inferred: FEA-019 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Decision: DEC-002]
135	
136	#### Acceptance criteria
137	
138	- **AC-004** Given a supplier registered by user A, When user A attempts to approve it, Then the approval is refused and the supplier's state is unchanged. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
139	- **AC-005** Given a signed-in user who is not a member of the Finance team, When they attempt to approve a supplier, Then the approval is refused and the supplier's state is unchanged. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
140	- **AC-006** Given a supplier whose bank details have been phone-verified and that was registered by user A, When Finance team member B (not A) approves it, Then the supplier is approved with that single approval. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
141	- **AC-007** Given a supplier whose bank details have not been phone-verified, or whose confirmed details did not match, When a Finance team member attempts to approve it, Then approval is not possible until the details are corrected and verified; whether corrected details need a fresh phone check is undecided (FR-016). [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
142	- **AC-008** Given a supplier awaiting approval, When a Finance team member rejects it, Then it goes back to the person who registered it. [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]
143	- **AC-009** Given a rejected supplier returned to its registrant, When the registrant corrects the details and resubmits, Then the supplier is submitted for approval again; whether re-verification is required is undecided (FR-016). [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]
144	- **AC-011** (draft) Given a supplier awaiting approval, When one Finance team member approves it while another rejects it at the same moment, Then only one decision takes effect; the mechanism is undecided. [Inferred: FEA-019 · Recommended (awaiting approval)]
145	
146	### Payment control
147	
148	#### Confirmed requirements
149	
150	- **FR-009** A new supplier must not be payable until a finance approver has approved it; the supplier's approval state must be authoritative for whether it can be paid. [Customer: FEA-006 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-002]
151	
152	#### Open behaviour (not yet decided)
153	
154	- **FR-015** Undecided: where supplier payments are made and how that place learns a supplier's approval state (Q-002); no supplied document describes a payment system. [Inferred: FEA-007 · Unknown]
155	
156	#### Recommendations awaiting approval
157	
158	None for this area.
159	
160	#### Acceptance criteria
161	
162	- **AC-010** Given a supplier that has not been approved, When a payment to that supplier is attempted, Then the payment is not allowed; the enforcement mechanism is undecided (FR-015). [Customer: FEA-006 · Explicit]
163	
164	### Audit records and notifications
165	
166	#### Confirmed requirements
167	
168	None. The customer has not stated an audit or notification requirement.
169	
170	#### Open behaviour (not yet decided)
171	
172	- **FR-018** Undecided: how Finance team members learn a supplier awaits approval, how the registrant learns a supplier was returned, through which channel, and what happens if a notice is not delivered (Q-007). [Inferred: FEA-014 · Unknown]
173	- **FR-019** Undecided: what is recorded for each registration, phone verification, approval and rejection (for example who acted, when, the outcome, the independently sourced number used) (Q-006). [Inferred: FEA-015 · Unknown]
174	
175	#### Recommendations awaiting approval
176	
177	- **FR-022** Recommendation: audit records for supplier registration, verification and approval are append-only so later edits cannot rewrite history. Low confidence: the source is generic fixture guidance. [Research: FEA-016 · Research-supported] [Research: F-GAP-007-02]
178	
179	#### Acceptance criteria
180	
181	- **AC-012** (draft) Given an audit record exists, When any user attempts to edit or delete it, Then the original record remains unchanged. [Research: FEA-016 · Research-supported] [Research: F-GAP-007-02]
182	
183	## 9. State Transitions and Edge Cases
184	
185	### Supplier lifecycle
186	
187	State names other than those quoted from the mockup are descriptive labels, not decided names.
188	
189	| State | Event | Next state | Who can trigger | Provenance |
190	|---|---|---|---|---|
191	| Not registered | Supplier submitted for approval | Awaiting approval | Procurement staff | [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Mockup: SCR-003 · Observed] |
192	| Awaiting approval | Bank details phone-verified and approved | Approved | Finance team member other than the registrant | [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002] |
193	| Awaiting approval | Rejected | Returned to registrant | Unknown (who may reject is not stated) | [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit] |
194	| Returned to registrant | Details corrected and resubmitted | Awaiting approval | The registrant | [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit] |
195	| Awaiting approval | Phone check finds bank details do not match | Unknown (rejection or a separate on-hold state; supplier cannot be approved until corrected) | Finance approver | [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] |
196	| Awaiting approval | Supplier cannot be reached by phone | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-008 · Unknown] |
197	| Approved | Bank details changed | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-010 · Unknown] |
198	| Awaiting approval | Duplicate VAT number submitted | Blocked at registration; no supplier created | Procurement staff | [Customer: FEA-004 · Explicit] |

203	
204	- **NFR-001** How long audit records are kept is set by the organisation's policy rather than by the user interface; the customer's retention policy has not been obtained. Low confidence: generic fixture guidance. [Research: FEA-017 · Research-supported] [Research: F-GAP-007-03]
205

209

269	## 17. Research Findings and Recommendations
270	
271	Research covered GAP-003 and GAP-007 only. The source for both kept findings is low confidence: a self-described test fixture, not COSO, UK audit practice or a recognised standards body.
272	
273	- F-GAP-007-02: "Audit records should be append-only so that later edits cannot rewrite history." Applies to GAP-007 because an editable approval or verification record cannot reliably trace a disputed payment. Limitation: generic audit-trail guidance, not specific to supplier master data or bank verification. Recommendation: see FR-022. [Research: F-GAP-007-02 · Research-supported] [Research: FEA-016 · Research-supported]
274	- F-GAP-007-03: retention periods for audit records are set by organisation policy, not by the user interface. Applies to GAP-007 because the retention period is a customer question. # Supplier Onboarding (New supplier registration and approval): Feature Specification

## 1. Document Status

- Run ID: 20261012-055017-ac3509
- Date: 2026-10-12
- Run mode: fixture
- Publication status: pending final pass
- Known limitations: Capture covers one page only (the New supplier form); no confirmation, error, empty or loading states, and no approver or verification screens, were captured. Research on bank detail changes after approval found no citable source (sources paywalled, members-only or off-topic). Research on audit records found only low-confidence generic fixture guidance, not COSO or UK audit practice; one finding was dropped in verification. Research for the deferred gaps was not performed.
- Open stale items: none
- Unresolved blocking issues: Q-001, Q-002, Q-003, Q-004 and Q-005 are blocking and unanswered (see section 16).

## 2. Executive Summary

This feature lets Procurement staff register a new supplier (company name, VAT number and bank details) and requires a Finance team member to approve it before the supplier can be paid. The customer also requires bank details to be verified before approval. The customer's answers say verification is a phone call to the supplier on a number from an independent source, that one approval from any Finance team member is enough, that the approver must differ from the registrant, and that a rejected supplier goes back to its registrant to correct and resubmit.

The only mockup screen captured is the registration form. It does not show where Finance verifies and approves, how payment is blocked, what the registrant sees after submitting, or how bank details are entered (the form has a file upload, while the customer defined three fields). Key open decisions are listed in section 16; five of them block a complete specification: where review and approval happen, how unapproved suppliers are kept from payment, what happens when bank details change after approval, what a failed phone check means, and how bank details are entered.

## 3. Goals and Scope

### Goals

- Procurement staff can register new suppliers with company name, VAT number and bank details. [Customer: REQ-001 · Conflicting]
- A new supplier cannot be paid until a Finance team member other than the registrant has approved it. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: FEA-006 · Explicit]
- Bank details are phone-verified before approval. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit]

### In Scope

- Supplier registration by Procurement staff, including the format-only VAT check and duplicate VAT blocking. [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Customer: FEA-004 · Explicit]
- Phone verification of bank details, approval by one Finance team member, and rejection with return to the registrant. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit]
- The approved gaps in section 7 (GAP-001 to GAP-007, GAP-009 and GAP-011) are in scope to be resolved; none is resolved yet.

### Out of Scope / Rejected

Information unavailable: no decision rejected an item and the customer's requirements excluded nothing. Exclusions are not inferred from absence in the mockup.

### Deferred

- GAP-008 (Deferred: DEC-005): who may register, view and edit suppliers and their bank details, and how long bank details and rejected registrations are kept.
- GAP-010 (Deferred: DEC-005): non-UK suppliers, accepted VAT number formats and required fields.
- GAP-012 (Deferred: DEC-005): accessibility of form errors, status messages and the file chooser.

## 4. Users and Roles

- Procurement staff register new suppliers. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit]
- Finance team members can approve a new supplier; one approval is enough; a finance approver phones the supplier to verify bank details. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit]
- Unknown: whether people outside Procurement staff are prevented from registering, whether a Finance team member who is also Procurement staff may register, and how the product identifies Finance and Procurement members. [Assumption: ASM-G-002 · Assumption]
- Unknown: whether the product can identify the individual who registers and the individual who approves. [Assumption: ASM-F-001 · Assumption]

## 5. Existing Mockup Coverage

- SCR-001 "New supplier" screen: a form with Company name and VAT number text inputs, a Bank details file chooser and a Submit for approval button; observed state is the default empty form only. [Mockup: SCR-001 · Observed]
- SCR-002 form component: no field shows a required marker; the action "Submit for approval" is a button that is not visibly disabled. [Mockup: SCR-002 · Observed]
- SCR-003 flow: the Submit for approval button has no target, so the destination after submitting is not shown. [Mockup: SCR-003 · Observed]
- SCR-004 Supplier data entity: Company name, VAT number and Bank details are visible fields; Approval status is inferred and not visible. [Mockup: SCR-004 · Observed]
- Ambiguous behaviours not answered by the mockup: required fields and validation rules; accepted file types, sizes and storage for Bank details; who can view bank details after upload; what happens on submit, on failure, and on resubmission; downstream changes and notifications.
- Capture limitation: one page captured with status complete; no confirmation, error, empty or loading states beyond the default form. Other screens may exist that were not captured. [Assumption: ASM-G-001 · Assumption]

## 6. Requirements Traceability

| REQ | Requirement | Treatment | Label | References |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| REQ-001 | Procurement staff register new suppliers with company name, VAT number and bank details. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-001, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006, FR-007, FR-013, FR-014, FR-017; DEC-004 |
| REQ-002 | A finance approver must approve a new supplier before it can be paid. | partially addressed | Unknown | FR-002, FR-008, FR-009, FR-011, FR-012, FR-015; DEC-002, DEC-003 |
| REQ-003 | Bank details must be verified before approval. | partially addressed | Unknown | FR-003, FR-010, FR-016; DEC-001 |

## 7. Gaps Identified

| GAP | Gap | Approval | Path | Priority | Status | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GAP-001 | Approval and bank-detail verification steps not shown in the capture | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | critical | open (customer decision pending: Q-001) | The capture shows only the registrant's form. |
| GAP-002 | How payment is blocked until a supplier is approved | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | critical | open (customer decision pending: Q-002) | No document says where payments are made or how an unapproved supplier is stopped. |
| GAP-003 | Bank details changed after approval | Approved: DEC-005 | both | critical | open (researched; customer decision pending: Q-003) | Research found no citable source; DEC-003 did not answer this part. |
| GAP-004 | Bank details captured as a file upload but defined as three data fields | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | important | open (customer decision pending: Q-005) | DEC-004 and the captured form disagree. |
| GAP-005 | Verification failure path versus rejection | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | important | open (customer decision pending: Q-004) | Whether a failed phone check is a rejection is not stated. |
| GAP-006 | Outcome of Submit for approval not shown in the capture | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | important | open (customer decision pending; recorded as implementation detail) | Success, error and upload failure states were not captured. |
| GAP-007 | Traceability of registration, verification and approval | Approved: DEC-005 | both | important | open (researched; customer decision pending: Q-006) | Two low-confidence findings kept; framework question unanswered. |
| GAP-008 | Who may register, view and edit suppliers and their bank details | Deferred: DEC-005 | both | important | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred by the customer. |
| GAP-009 | Who is told when a supplier is submitted or returned | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | important | open (customer decision pending: Q-007) | Notification channel and delivery failure not defined. |
| GAP-010 | Non-UK suppliers and field formats | Deferred: DEC-005 | both | important | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred by the customer. |
| GAP-011 | Duplicate and simultaneous submissions | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | optional | open (customer decision pending: Q-008) | Which records count as existing is not stated. |
| GAP-012 | Accessibility of the registration form errors and file upload | Deferred: DEC-005 | research | optional | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred by the customer. |

## 8. Functional Requirements

### Supplier registration

Procurement staff register a new supplier on the New supplier form and submit it for approval.

#### Confirmed requirements

- **FR-004** Registration of new suppliers is performed by Procurement staff. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-001]
- **FR-005** Bank details consist of account name, sort code and account number. [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
- **FR-006** The VAT number is checked for format only. Which formats count as valid is not stated. [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
- **FR-007** A supplier with the same VAT number as an existing supplier is blocked at registration. [Customer: FEA-004 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]

#### Open behaviour (not yet decided)

- **FR-001** Not confirmed while the conflict is open (Q-005): the customer states that Procurement staff register new suppliers with company name, VAT number and bank details, but the captured form collects bank details only as a file upload. [Customer: REQ-001 · Conflicting] [Decision: DEC-004] [Mockup: SCR-002]
- **FR-013** Undecided: whether bank details are typed as account name, sort code and account number, uploaded as a file, or both, and which values are verified and stored (Q-005). [Inferred: FEA-012 · Unknown]
- **FR-014** Undecided: what the registrant sees on successful submission, invalid VAT format, blocked duplicate VAT number and upload failure, and how they later find a returned supplier. [Inferred: FEA-013 · Unknown]
- **FR-017** Undecided: which supplier records (pending, rejected, returned) count as existing for the duplicate VAT rule, and what happens on simultaneous or repeated submission (Q-008). [Inferred: FEA-005 · Unknown]

#### Recommendations awaiting approval

None for this area.

#### Acceptance criteria

- **AC-001** Given a Procurement staff member on the New supplier form, When they submit a company name, a VAT number in a valid format, and bank details (account name, sort code, account number), Then the supplier is created awaiting Finance approval and is not payable; what the registrant sees is undecided (FR-014). [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
- **AC-002** Given a Procurement staff member on the New supplier form, When they submit a VAT number that fails the format check, Then no supplier is created; the message wording is undecided (FR-014). [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
- **AC-003** Given an existing supplier with VAT number V, When a Procurement staff member submits a new supplier with VAT number V, Then the submission is blocked and no new supplier is created; whether pending or rejected suppliers count as existing is undecided (FR-017). [Customer: FEA-004 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]

### Verification and approval

A Finance team member phones the supplier to verify bank details and then approves or rejects the supplier.

#### Confirmed requirements

- **FR-008** Only members of the Finance team can approve a new supplier; one approval is sufficient; the approver must be a different person from whoever registered the supplier. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **FR-010** Before approval, a finance approver phones the supplier on a number from an independent source and confirms the bank details; if they do not match, the supplier cannot be approved until the details are corrected. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **FR-011** A rejected supplier goes back to the person who registered it, who can correct the details and resubmit it. [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]

#### Open behaviour (not yet decided)

- **FR-002** The customer states that a finance approver must approve a new supplier before it can be paid; this item is not fully settled, and how payment is blocked remains unknown (Q-002). [Customer: REQ-002 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **FR-003** The customer states that bank details must be verified before approval; this item is not fully settled, and where and how verification is recorded remains unknown (Q-001, Q-004). [Customer: REQ-003 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **FR-012** Undecided: where and how a Finance team member finds a submitted supplier, records the phone verification, and approves or rejects it; only the registration form was captured (Q-001). [Inferred: FEA-011 · Unknown]
- **FR-016** Undecided: whether changing an approved supplier's bank details requires re-verification and re-approval, who may make the change, and whether payments are held meanwhile; also whether a failed phone check is a rejection or a separate state, what happens if the supplier cannot be reached, and whether corrected details need a new phone check (Q-003, Q-004). [Inferred: FEA-010 · Unknown]

#### Recommendations awaiting approval

- **FR-020** Recommendation: record reliably which person registered each supplier and which person attempts approval, including after a returned supplier is corrected and resubmitted, so the separation-of-duties rule can be enforced. [Inferred: FEA-018 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Assumption: ASM-F-001 · Assumption] [Assumption: ASM-F-002 · Assumption]
- **FR-021** Recommendation: consider what happens if two Finance members act on the same supplier at once, so that only one decision takes effect. [Inferred: FEA-019 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Decision: DEC-002]

#### Acceptance criteria

- **AC-004** Given a supplier registered by user A, When user A attempts to approve it, Then the approval is refused and the supplier's state is unchanged. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **AC-005** Given a user who is not a member of the Finance team (how the product identifies team membership and individuals is unestablished), When they attempt to approve a supplier, Then the approval is refused and the supplier's state is unchanged. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002] [Assumption: ASM-F-001] [Assumption: ASM-G-002]
- **AC-006** Given a supplier whose bank details have been phone-verified and that was registered by user A, When Finance team member B (not A) approves it, Then the supplier is approved with that single approval. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **AC-007** Given a supplier whose bank details have not been phone-verified, or whose confirmed details did not match, When a Finance team member attempts to approve it, Then approval is not possible until the details are corrected and verified; whether corrected details need a fresh phone check is undecided (FR-016). [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **AC-008** Given a supplier awaiting approval, When a Finance team member rejects it, Then it goes back to the person who registered it. [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]
- **AC-009** Given a rejected supplier returned to its registrant, When the registrant corrects the details and resubmits, Then the supplier is submitted for approval again; whether re-verification is required is undecided (FR-016). [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]
- **AC-011** (draft) Given a supplier awaiting approval, When one Finance team member approves it while another rejects it at the same moment, Then only one decision takes effect; the mechanism is undecided. [Inferred: FEA-019 · Recommended (awaiting approval)]

### Payment control

#### Confirmed requirements

- **FR-009** A new supplier must not be payable until a finance approver has approved it; the supplier's approval state must be authoritative for whether it can be paid. [Customer: FEA-006 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-002]

#### Open behaviour (not yet decided)

- **FR-015** Undecided: where supplier payments are made and how that place learns a supplier's approval state (Q-002); no supplied document describes a payment system. [Inferred: FEA-007 · Unknown]

#### Recommendations awaiting approval

None for this area.

#### Acceptance criteria

- **AC-010** Given a supplier that has not been approved, When a payment to that supplier is attempted, Then the payment is not allowed; the enforcement mechanism is undecided (FR-015). [Customer: FEA-006 · Explicit]

### Audit records and notifications

#### Confirmed requirements

None. The customer has not stated an audit or notification requirement.

#### Open behaviour (not yet decided)

- **FR-018** Undecided: how Finance team members learn a supplier awaits approval, how the registrant learns a supplier was returned, through which channel, and what happens if a notice is not delivered (Q-007). [Inferred: FEA-014 · Unknown]
- **FR-019** Undecided: what is recorded for each registration, phone verification, approval and rejection (for example who acted, when, the outcome, the independently sourced number used) (Q-006). [Inferred: FEA-015 · Unknown]

#### Recommendations awaiting approval

- **FR-022** Recommendation: audit records for supplier registration, verification and approval are append-only so later edits cannot rewrite history. Low confidence: the source is generic fixture guidance. [Research: FEA-016 · Research-supported] [Research: F-GAP-007-02]

#### Acceptance criteria

- **AC-012** (draft) Given an audit record exists, When any user attempts to edit or delete it, Then the original record remains unchanged. [Research: FEA-016 · Research-supported] [Research: F-GAP-007-02]

## 9. State Transitions and Edge Cases

### Supplier lifecycle

State names other than those quoted from the mockup are descriptive labels, not decided names.

| State | Event | Next state | Who can trigger | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Not registered | Supplier submitted for approval | Awaiting approval | Procurement staff | [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Mockup: SCR-003 · Observed] |
| Awaiting approval | Bank details phone-verified and approved | Approved | Finance team member other than the registrant | [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002] |
| Awaiting approval | Rejected | Returned to registrant | Unknown (who may reject is not stated) | [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit] |
| Returned to registrant | Details corrected and resubmitted | Awaiting approval | The registrant | [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit] |
| Awaiting approval | Phone check finds bank details do not match | Unknown (rejection or a separate on-hold state; supplier cannot be approved until corrected) | Finance approver | [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] |
| Awaiting approval | Supplier cannot be reached by phone | Unknown | Unknown | [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] |
| Approved | Bank details changed | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-010 · Unknown] |
| Not registered | Duplicate VAT number submitted | Not registered (submission blocked; no supplier created) | Procurement staff | [Customer: FEA-004 · Explicit] |

The unreachable-by-phone row cites FEA-008 for the phone verification requirement only; what happens when the supplier cannot be reached is an open uncertainty, so its next state and who can trigger it are Unknown (Q-004).

Edge cases not decided: simultaneous submission of the same supplier, simultaneous approve and reject, notification failure, upload failure (see section 16).

## 10. Non-Functional Requirements

- **NFR-001** How long audit records are kept is set by the organisation's policy rather than by the user interface; the customer's retention policy has not been obtained. Low confidence: generic fixture guidance. [Research: FEA-017 · Research-supported] [Research: F-GAP-007-03]

No performance, availability or compliance requirements are available: no input or kept evidence states any.

## 11. Data Model and Business Rules

Entity Supplier. No schema was inspected; fields below come from the mockup and customer answers.

| Field | Basis | Provenance |
|---|---|---|
| Company name | Visible on the form | [Mockup: SCR-004 · Observed] |
| VAT number | Visible on the form | [Mockup: SCR-004 · Observed] |
| Bank details | Visible as a file input; customer defined account name, sort code and account number | [Mockup: SCR-004 · Observed] [Decision: DEC-004] |
| Approval status | Inferred, not visible | [Mockup: SCR-004 · Observed] |

- **BR-001** The approver of a supplier must be a different person from whoever registered it. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **BR-002** One approval is enough to approve a supplier. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **BR-003** A supplier that has not been approved must not be payable. [Customer: FEA-006 · Explicit]
- **BR-004** A supplier whose bank details do not match the phone confirmation cannot be approved until the details are corrected. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **BR-005** A supplier with the same VAT number as an existing supplier is blocked. [Customer: FEA-004 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]

## 12. Screens and User Flows

- Registration: Procurement staff open New supplier, enter company name and VAT number, choose a Bank details file, and press Submit for approval; the button has no target in the capture. [Mockup: SCR-003 · Observed]
- Review, verification, approval and rejection screens are not shown in the capture and may exist elsewhere (Q-001). [Assumption: ASM-G-001 · Assumption]

## 13. Integrations and Dependencies

Unknown: no supplied document describes a payment system, a notification mechanism or sign-in; whether payments are made in this product or elsewhere is undecided (FR-015, Q-002). [Inferred: FEA-007 · Unknown]

## 14. Security, Privacy, and Error Handling

- Separation of duties between registrant and approver depends on the product identifying individuals. [Assumption: ASM-F-001 · Assumption]
- Who can view or edit stored bank details, and their retention, are not specified here; that topic is deferred (see Deferred in section 3).
- Error handling for invalid VAT format, duplicate VAT, upload failure and notification failure is undecided (FR-014, FR-018). [Inferred: FEA-013 · Unknown]

## 15. Decisions Log

| DEC-001 | 1 | 2026-10-12 | Verification means a finance approver phones the supplier on a number from an independent source and confirms the bank details; if they do not match, the supplier cannot be approved until the details are corrected. | Pre-written eval answer matched to CQ-001 by keywords. REQ-003 approved; issue unknown cleared (label still derived as Unknown). | REQ-003 | none |
| DEC-002 | 1 | 2026-10-12 | Any member of the Finance team can approve a new supplier. One approval is enough, but the approver must be a different person from whoever registered the supplier. | Pre-written eval answer matched to CQ-002 by keywords. REQ-002 approved; issue unknown cleared (label still derived as Unknown). | REQ-002 | none |
| DEC-003 | 1 | 2026-10-12 | A rejected supplier goes back to the person who registered it, who can correct the details and resubmit it. | Pre-written eval answer matched to CQ-003 by keywords. No status actions recorded; the post-approval bank change part of CQ-003 was not answered. | REQ-002, REQ-003 | none |
| DEC-004 | 1 | 2026-10-12 | Bank details are account name, sort code and account number. The VAT number is checked for format only, and a supplier with the same VAT number as an existing one is blocked. | Pre-written eval answer matched to CQ-004 by keywords. REQ-001 approved; derived label Conflicting because the captured form uses a file upload. | REQ-001 | none |
| DEC-005 | 2 | 2026-10-12 | Approve this gap; research is limited to the first two research gaps. | Gap decisions from the eval case file: GAP-001 to GAP-007, GAP-009 and GAP-011 approved; GAP-008, GAP-010 and GAP-012 deferred. | GAP-001 to GAP-012 | none |

## 16. Open Questions and Assumptions

| ID | Text | Why it matters | Related items | Impact | Blocking | Owner | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q-001 | Besides the New supplier form, are there other screens where Finance finds a submitted supplier, records the phone check and approves or rejects it? If not, should they be designed? | Approval and verification have nowhere to happen in the product otherwise. | GAP-001, FEA-011, REQ-002, REQ-003 | Workflow cannot be specified | yes | Customer | Unanswered |

| Q-004 | When the phone check finds a mismatch, is the supplier rejected to the registrant or held separately? What if unreachable? Is a new phone check needed after correction? | Defines supplier states and who acts. | GAP-005, FEA-008, FEA-009, FEA-018, REQ-002, REQ-003 | States and transitions undefined | yes | Customer | Unanswered |
| Q-005 | Should bank details be typed as three fields, uploaded as a file, or both? | The form and stored record must hold what is verified and paid to. | GAP-004, FEA-012, FEA-003, REQ-001 | Form and record cannot be specified | yes | Customer | Unanswered |
| Q-006 | What should be recorded about each registration, phone check, approval and rejection, and how long kept? One unanswered research question also remains for GAP-007: what audit evidence common internal-control frameworks (for example COSO or UK audit practice for purchase-to-pay) expect for supplier creation, bank detail verification and approval. | Needed to check separation of duties and trace disputed payments. Option recommended on low-confidence research, awaiting confirmation. | GAP-007, FEA-015, FEA-016, FEA-017 | Audit content and retention undefined | no | Customer | Unanswered (research question also unanswered) |
| Q-007 | How should Finance be told a supplier awaits approval, and the registrant told it was returned? | Submissions and returns may stall unnoticed. | GAP-009, FEA-014, REQ-002 | Notification behaviour undefined | no | Customer | Unanswered |
| Q-008 | For the duplicate VAT rule, do pending or rejected suppliers count as existing? What if two people submit the same supplier at once? | Decides resubmission and duplicate risk. | GAP-011, FEA-004, FEA-005, REQ-001 | Duplicate handling undefined | no | Customer | Unanswered |
| ASM-G-001 | The capture contains only the registrant's form; approver and verification screens may exist in parts of the mockup that were not captured. | GAP-001 and GAP-006 are treated as unobserved rather than absent. | GAP-001, GAP-006 | Scope of missing screens | no | Customer | Assumption, unconfirmed |
| ASM-G-002 | Membership of the Finance team and of Procurement staff can be determined from an existing role or group in the product. | DEC-002 requires the product to know who is on the Finance team. | GAP-001 | Permission model needs a source of team membership if no role exists | no | Customer | Assumption, unconfirmed |
| ASM-F-001 | The product can identify the signed-in person who registers a supplier and the person who approves it. | Separation of duties can only be enforced if both are known. | FEA-001, FEA-018 | Rule cannot be enforced without identities | no | Customer | Assumption, unconfirmed |
| ASM-F-002 | After a returned supplier is corrected and resubmitted, the original registrant remains the registrant for the separation-of-duties rule. | DEC-003 does not say the role changes. | FEA-009, FEA-018 | Rule may need to bar the corrector from approving too | no | Customer | Assumption, unconfirmed |

No stale items.

## 17. Research Findings and Recommendations

Research covered GAP-003 and GAP-007 only. The source for both kept findings is low confidence: a self-described test fixture, not COSO, UK audit practice or a recognised standards body.

- F-GAP-007-02: "Audit records should be append-only so that later edits cannot rewrite history." Applies to GAP-007 because an editable approval or verification record cannot reliably trace a disputed payment. Limitation: generic audit-trail guidance, not specific to supplier master data or bank verification. Recommendation: see FR-022. [Research: F-GAP-007-02 · Research-supported] [Research: FEA-016 · Research-supported]
- F-GAP-007-03: retention periods for audit records are set by organisation policy, not by the user interface. Applies to GAP-007 because the retention period is a customer question. Limitation: names no period; the customer's policy is unknown. See NFR-001. [Research: F-GAP-007-03 · Research-supported] [Research: FEA-017 · Research-supported]
- Research for GAP-003 found no citable source (see Limitations), so Q-003 has no research-backed recommendation.

## 18. Sources

URL, fetched date and robots note below come from sources/SRC-24ac1554.metadata.json (original_url, fetched_at, warnings).

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SRC-24ac1554 | Audit trails for approval decisions (fixture guidance) | https://docs.fixture.example/audit-trail | docs.fixture.example (unknown publisher; metadata type official_documentation) | 2025-03-01 | 2026-10-12 | F-GAP-007-02, F-GAP-007-03 | Self-described test fixture; generic guidance; low confidence; metadata warning: "fixture mode: robots.txt not checked (no network)" |

### Limitations

- F-GAP-007-01 (Dropped): a recommendation to record actor, decision, timestamp and before and after state for registration, phone verification, approval and rejection was dropped in verification because the source covers only "an audit record for an approval decision" and does not address registration or phone verification. It is not used as evidence.
- GAP-003: both research questions (controls for bank detail changes; Confirmation of Payee) remain unanswered because the relevant results were paywalled, members-only or off-topic and nothing could be cited (listed as open in Q-003).
- GAP-007: the question about COSO or UK purchase-to-pay audit evidence remains unanswered; the only fetchable source was generic fixture guidance (listed as open in Q-006).

1	# Supplier Onboarding (New supplier registration and approval): Feature Specification
2	
3	## 1. Document Status
4	
5	- Run ID: 20261012-055017-ac3509
6	- Date: 2026-10-12
7	- Run mode: fixture
8	- Publication status: pending final pass
9	- Known limitations: Capture covers one page only (the New supplier form); no confirmation, error, empty or loading states, and no approver or verification screens, were captured. Research on bank detail changes after approval found no citable source (sources paywalled, members-only or off-topic). Research on audit records found only low-confidence generic fixture guidance, not COSO or UK audit practice; one finding was dropped in verification. Research for the deferred gaps was not performed.
10	- Open stale items: none
11	- Unresolved blocking issues: Q-001, Q-002, Q-003, Q-004 and Q-005 are blocking and unanswered (see section 16).
12	
13	## 2. Executive Summary
14	
15	This feature lets Procurement staff register a new supplier (company name, VAT number and bank details) and requires a Finance team member to approve it before the supplier can be paid. The customer also requires bank details to be verified before approval. The customer's answers say verification is a phone call to the supplier on a number from an independent source, that one approval from any Finance team member is enough, that the approver must differ from the registrant, and that a rejected supplier goes back to its registrant to correct and resubmit.
16	
17	The only mockup screen captured is the registration form. It does not show where Finance verifies and approves, how payment is blocked, what the registrant sees after submitting, or how bank details are entered (the form has a file upload, while the customer defined three fields). Key open decisions are listed in section 16; five of them block a complete specification: where review and approval happen, how unapproved suppliers are kept from payment, what happens when bank details change after approval, what a failed phone check means, and how bank details are entered.
18	
19	## 3. Goals and Scope
20	
21	### Goals
22	
23	- Procurement staff can register new suppliers with company name, VAT number and bank details. [Customer: REQ-001 · Conflicting]
24	- A new supplier cannot be paid until a Finance team member other than the registrant has approved it. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: FEA-006 · Explicit]
25	- Bank details are phone-verified before approval. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit]
26	
27	### In Scope
28	
29	- Supplier registration by Procurement staff, including the format-only VAT check and duplicate VAT blocking. [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Customer: FEA-004 · Explicit]
30	- Phone verification of bank details, approval by one Finance team member, and rejection with return to the registrant. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit]
31	- The approved gaps in section 7 (GAP-001 to GAP-007, GAP-009 and GAP-011) are in scope to be resolved; none is resolved yet.
32	
33	### Out of Scope / Rejected
34	
35	Information unavailable: no decision rejected an item and the customer's requirements excluded nothing. Exclusions are not inferred from absence in the mockup.
36	
37	### Deferred
38	
39	- GAP-008 (Deferred: DEC-005): who may register, view and edit suppliers and their bank details, and how long bank details and rejected registrations are kept.
40	- GAP-010 (Deferred: DEC-005): non-UK suppliers, accepted VAT number formats and required fields.
41	- GAP-012 (Deferred: DEC-005): accessibility of form errors, status messages and the file chooser.
42	
43	## 4. Users and Roles
44	
45	- Procurement staff register new suppliers. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit]
46	- Finance team members can approve a new supplier; one approval is enough; a finance approver phones the supplier to verify bank details. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit]
47	- Unknown: whether people outside Procurement staff are prevented from registering, whether a Finance team member who is also Procurement staff may register, and how the product identifies Finance and Procurement members. [Assumption: ASM-G-002 · Assumption]
48	- Unknown: whether the product can identify the individual who registers and the individual who approves. [Assumption: ASM-F-001 · Assumption]
49	
50	## 5. Existing Mockup Coverage
51	
52	- SCR-001 "New supplier" screen: a form with Company name and VAT number text inputs, a Bank details file chooser and a Submit for approval button; observed state is the default empty form only. [Mockup: SCR-001 · Observed]
53	- SCR-002 form component: no field shows a required marker; the action "Submit for approval" is a button that is not visibly disabled. [Mockup: SCR-002 · Observed]
54	- SCR-003 flow: the Submit for approval button has no target, so the destination after submitting is not shown. [Mockup: SCR-003 · Observed]
55	- SCR-004 Supplier data entity: Company name, VAT number and Bank details are visible fields; Approval status is inferred and not visible. [Mockup: SCR-004 · Observed]
56	- Ambiguous behaviours not answered by the mockup: required fields and validation rules; accepted file types, sizes and storage for Bank details; who can view bank details after upload; what happens on submit, on failure, and on resubmission; downstream changes and notifications.
57	- Capture limitation: one page captured with status complete; no confirmation, error, empty or loading states beyond the default form. Other screens may exist that were not captured. [Assumption: ASM-G-001 · Assumption]
58	
59	## 6. Requirements Traceability
60	
61	| REQ | Requirement | Treatment | Label | References |
62	|---|---|---|---|---|
63	| REQ-001 | Procurement staff register new suppliers with company name, VAT number and bank details. | partially addressed | Conflicting | FR-001, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006, FR-007, FR-013, FR-014, FR-017; DEC-004 |
64	| REQ-002 | A finance approver must approve a new supplier before it can be paid. | partially addressed | Unknown | FR-002, FR-008, FR-009, FR-011, FR-012, FR-015; DEC-002, DEC-003 |
65	| REQ-003 | Bank details must be verified before approval. | partially addressed | Unknown | FR-003, FR-010, FR-016; DEC-001 |
66	
67	## 7. Gaps Identified
68	
69	| GAP | Gap | Approval | Path | Priority | Status | Rationale |
70	|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
71	| GAP-001 | Approval and bank-detail verification steps not shown in the capture | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | critical | open (customer decision pending: Q-001) | The capture shows only the registrant's form. |
72	| GAP-002 | How payment is blocked until a supplier is approved | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | critical | open (customer decision pending: Q-002) | No document says where payments are made or how an unapproved supplier is stopped. |
73	| GAP-003 | Bank details changed after approval | Approved: DEC-005 | both | critical | open (researched; customer decision pending: Q-003) | Research found no citable source; DEC-003 did not answer this part. |
74	| GAP-004 | Bank details captured as a file upload but defined as three data fields | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | important | open (customer decision pending: Q-005) | DEC-004 and the captured form disagree. |
75	| GAP-005 | Verification failure path versus rejection | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | important | open (customer decision pending: Q-004) | Whether a failed phone check is a rejection is not stated. |
76	| GAP-006 | Outcome of Submit for approval not shown in the capture | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | important | open (customer decision pending; recorded as implementation detail) | Success, error and upload failure states were not captured. |
77	| GAP-007 | Traceability of registration, verification and approval | Approved: DEC-005 | both | important | open (researched; customer decision pending: Q-006) | Two low-confidence findings kept; framework question unanswered. |
78	| GAP-008 | Who may register, view and edit suppliers and their bank details | Deferred: DEC-005 | both | important | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred by the customer. |
79	| GAP-009 | Who is told when a supplier is submitted or returned | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | important | open (customer decision pending: Q-007) | Notification channel and delivery failure not defined. |
80	| GAP-010 | Non-UK suppliers and field formats | Deferred: DEC-005 | both | important | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred by the customer. |
81	| GAP-011 | Duplicate and simultaneous submissions | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | optional | open (customer decision pending: Q-008) | Which records count as existing is not stated. |
82	| GAP-012 | Accessibility of the registration form errors and file upload | Deferred: DEC-005 | research | optional | open (deferred by DEC-005) | Deferred by the customer. |
83	
84	## 8. Functional Requirements
85	
86	### Supplier registration
87	
88	Procurement staff register a new supplier on the New supplier form and submit it for approval.
89	
90	#### Confirmed requirements
91	
92	- **FR-004** Registration of new suppliers is performed by Procurement staff. [Customer: FEA-002 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-001]
93	- **FR-005** Bank details consist of account name, sort code and account number. [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
94	- **FR-006** The VAT number is checked for format only. Which formats count as valid is not stated. [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
95	- **FR-007** A supplier with the same VAT number as an existing supplier is blocked at registration. [Customer: FEA-004 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
96	
97	#### Open behaviour (not yet decided)
98	
99	- **FR-001** Not confirmed while the conflict is open (Q-005): the customer states that Procurement staff register new suppliers with company name, VAT number and bank details, but the captured form collects bank details only as a file upload. [Customer: REQ-001 · Conflicting] [Decision: DEC-004] [Mockup: SCR-002]
100	- **FR-013** Undecided: whether bank details are typed as account name, sort code and account number, uploaded as a file, or both, and which values are verified and stored (Q-005). [Inferred: FEA-012 · Unknown]
101	- **FR-014** Undecided: what the registrant sees on successful submission, invalid VAT format, blocked duplicate VAT number and upload failure, and how they later find a returned supplier. [Inferred: FEA-013 · Unknown]
102	- **FR-017** Undecided: which supplier records (pending, rejected, returned) count as existing for the duplicate VAT rule, and what happens on simultaneous or repeated submission (Q-008). [Inferred: FEA-005 · Unknown]
103	
104	#### Recommendations awaiting approval
105	
106	None for this area.
107	
108	#### Acceptance criteria
109	
110	- **AC-001** Given a Procurement staff member on the New supplier form, When they submit a company name, a VAT number in a valid format, and bank details (account name, sort code, account number), Then the supplier is created awaiting Finance approval and is not payable; what the registrant sees is undecided (FR-014). [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
111	- **AC-002** Given a Procurement staff member on the New supplier form, When they submit a VAT number that fails the format check, Then no supplier is created; the message wording is undecided (FR-014). [Customer: FEA-003 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
112	- **AC-003** Given an existing supplier with VAT number V, When a Procurement staff member submits a new supplier with VAT number V, Then the submission is blocked and no new supplier is created; whether pending or rejected suppliers count as existing is undecided (FR-017). [Customer: FEA-004 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]
113	
114	### Verification and approval
115	
116	A Finance team member phones the supplier to verify bank details and then approves or rejects the supplier.
117	
118	#### Confirmed requirements
119	
120	- **FR-008** Only members of the Finance team can approve a new supplier; one approval is sufficient; the approver must be a different person from whoever registered the supplier. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
121	- **FR-010** Before approval, a finance approver phones the supplier on a number from an independent source and confirms the bank details; if they do not match, the supplier cannot be approved until the details are corrected. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
122	- **FR-011** A rejected supplier goes back to the person who registered it, who can correct the details and resubmit it. [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]
123	
124	#### Open behaviour (not yet decided)
125	
126	- **FR-002** The customer states that a finance approver must approve a new supplier before it can be paid; this item is not fully settled, and how payment is blocked remains unknown (Q-002). [Customer: REQ-002 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-002]
127	- **FR-003** The customer states that bank details must be verified before approval; this item is not fully settled, and where and how verification is recorded remains unknown (Q-001, Q-004). [Customer: REQ-003 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-001]
128	- **FR-012** Undecided: where and how a Finance team member finds a submitted supplier, records the phone verification, and approves or rejects it; only the registration form was captured (Q-001). [Inferred: FEA-011 · Unknown]
129	- **FR-016** Undecided: whether changing an approved supplier's bank details requires re-verification and re-approval, who may make the change, and whether payments are held meanwhile; also whether a failed phone check is a rejection or a separate state, what happens if the supplier cannot be reached, and whether corrected details need a new phone check (Q-003, Q-004). [Inferred: FEA-010 · Unknown]
130	
131	#### Recommendations awaiting approval
132	
133	- **FR-020** Recommendation: record reliably which person registered each supplier and which person attempts approval, including after a returned supplier is corrected and resubmitted, so the separation-of-duties rule can be enforced. [Inferred: FEA-018 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Assumption: ASM-F-001 · Assumption] [Assumption: ASM-F-002 · Assumption]
134	- **FR-021** Recommendation: consider what happens if two Finance members act on the same supplier at once, so that only one decision takes effect. [Inferred: FEA-019 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Decision: DEC-002]
135	
136	#### Acceptance criteria
137	
138	- **AC-004** Given a supplier registered by user A, When user A attempts to approve it, Then the approval is refused and the supplier's state is unchanged. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
139	- **AC-005** Given a user who is not a member of the Finance team (how the product identifies team membership and individuals is unestablished), When they attempt to approve a supplier, Then the approval is refused and the supplier's state is unchanged. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002] [Assumption: ASM-F-001] [Assumption: ASM-G-002]
140	- **AC-006** Given a supplier whose bank details have been phone-verified and that was registered by user A, When Finance team member B (not A) approves it, Then the supplier is approved with that single approval. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
141	- **AC-007** Given a supplier whose bank details have not been phone-verified, or whose confirmed details did not match, When a Finance team member attempts to approve it, Then approval is not possible until the details are corrected and verified; whether corrected details need a fresh phone check is undecided (FR-016). [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
142	- **AC-008** Given a supplier awaiting approval, When a Finance team member rejects it, Then it goes back to the person who registered it. [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]
143	- **AC-009** Given a rejected supplier returned to its registrant, When the registrant corrects the details and resubmits, Then the supplier is submitted for approval again; whether re-verification is required is undecided (FR-016). [Customer: FEA-009 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]
144	- **AC-011** (draft) Given a supplier awaiting approval, When one Finance team member approves it while another rejects it at the same moment, Then only one decision takes effect; the mechanism is undecided. [Inferred: FEA-019 · Recommended (awaiting approval)]
145	
146	### Payment control
147	
148	#### Confirmed requirements
149	
150	- **FR-009** A new supplier must not be payable until a finance approver has approved it; the supplier's approval state must be authoritative for whether it can be paid. [Customer: FEA-006 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-002]
151	
152	#### Open behaviour (not yet decided)
153	
154	- **FR-015** Undecided: where supplier payments are made and how that place learns a supplier's approval state (Q-002); no supplied document describes a payment system. [Inferred: FEA-007 · Unknown]
155	
156	#### Recommendations awaiting approval
157	
158	None for this area.
159	
160	#### Acceptance criteria
161	
162	- **AC-010** Given a supplier that has not been approved, When a payment to that supplier is attempted, Then the payment is not allowed; the enforcement mechanism is undecided (FR-015). [Customer: FEA-006 · Explicit]
163	
164	### Audit records and notifications
165	
166	#### Confirmed requirements
167	
168	None. The customer has not stated an audit or notification requirement.
169	
170	#### Open behaviour (not yet decided)
171	
172	- **FR-018** Undecided: how Finance team members learn a supplier awaits approval, how the registrant learns a supplier was returned, through which channel, and what happens if a notice is not delivered (Q-007). [Inferred: FEA-014 · Unknown]
173	- **FR-019** Undecided: what is recorded for each registration, phone verification, approval and rejection (for example who acted, when, the outcome, the independently sourced number used) (Q-006). [Inferred: FEA-015 · Unknown]
174	
175	#### Recommendations awaiting approval
176	
177	- **FR-022** Recommendation: audit records for supplier registration, verification and approval are append-only so later edits cannot rewrite history. Low confidence: the source is generic fixture guidance. [Research: FEA-016 · Research-supported] [Research: F-GAP-007-02]
178	
179	#### Acceptance criteria
180	
181	- **AC-012** (draft) Given an audit record exists, When any user attempts to edit or delete it, Then the original record remains unchanged. [Research: FEA-016 · Research-supported] [Research: F-GAP-007-02]
182	
183	## 9. State Transitions and Edge Cases
184	
185	### Supplier lifecycle
186	
187	State names other than those quoted from the mockup are descriptive labels, not decided names.
188
